title: Chemistry-Biology Interfaces Seminar
description: This course supports the Chemistry-Biology Interfaces Training Program and will meet for weekly training activity workshops. These workshops will rotate through student presentations on their thesis research, grant writing workshops, panel discussions, and student presentations on current chemical biology literature works. S/U grades only. May be taken for credit up to fifteen times. Prerequisites: graduate standing and department approval required. This course is only open for students supported or affiliated with the Chemistry-Biology Interfaces Training Program.
